# telnyx_pronunciation_dictionary (Data Source)

A pronunciation dictionary, which tells text-to-speech how to say words such as names and acronyms.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the pronunciation dictionary.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp with millisecond precision.
- `items` (Attributes List) List of pronunciation items (alias or phoneme type). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the dictionary. Must be unique within the organization.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the resource type.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp with millisecond precision.
- `version` (Number) Auto-incrementing version number. Increases by 1 on each update. Used for optimistic concurrency control and cache invalidation.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `alias` (String) The replacement text that will be spoken instead.
- `alphabet` (String) The phonetic alphabet used for the phoneme notation. One of `ipa`.
- `phoneme` (String) The phoneme notation representing the desired pronunciation.
- `text` (String) The text to match in the input. Case-insensitive matching is used during synthesis.
- `type` (String) One of `alias`, `phoneme`.
